 CFB CHAOS: 5 Top 7 Teams Fall, Bryce Underwood's Future & Jon Gruden Recaps NFL Week 6
 Wake Up Barstool 10/19/2026 6:30 PM Facebook Icon College football delivered one of the most chaotic weekends in history as five of the AP Top 7 teams lost on the same day for the first time ever! Dave Portnoy and Brandon Walker react to the madness and reveal their updated Top 10 college football rankings.
 Is Bryce Underwood's time at Michigan coming to an end? Dave Portnoy weighs in on the Wolverines' quarterback situation. Ohio State survives Indiana in a 19-15 thriller, Miami takes down Florida State 43-35 in double overtime, and BYU stuns Notre Dame 28-24 for its first win over a Top 10 team since 2018.
 In the NFL, the Green Bay Packers dominate the Dallas Cowboys 23-13 on Sunday Night Football. Coach Jon Gruden joins Wake Up Barstool to recap NFL Week 6, breaking down the biggest games, standout performances, and major storylines from around the league.
 Plus, the Tampa Bay Rays defeat the Cleveland Guardians 3-1 to take a 3-2 lead in the ALCS.
